svg.text: One Cognito sign-in, one code-server per user: MicroVM through a local relay or CloudFront + Lambda@Edge, or a private EC2 instance through Session Manager
MicroVM sessions: Path A (local relay) and Path B (browser only)
one per session, suspends when idle
HTTPS + WSS with X-aws-proxy-auth, token refreshed from the control plane
